related.description: Finder context menu automation for macOS. Run scripts on selected files with a right-click.
✨ Finder Toolbar app for macOS to open the current directory in Terminal, iTerm, Hyper or Alacritty.
This is a app for macOS that to open a new Finder window and change the current directory to the folder this app launched.
Save all your Mac apps for later with one click 🖱️
